title: Secret Million Dollar Claude and Shopify Hack #business #ai #aibusinessideas
description:
This is a dead simple Claude AI hack for finding your next product idea — no market research tools, no paid courses, no guessing. You take the negative reviews from any bestselling Tiktok product, run them through Claude, and it tells you exactly what buyers hate and what the ideal version would look like. That's your product spec, handed to you by real customers who already paid money and got burned.

Works for Amazon FBA, Etsy, Shopify, or any digital product you want to build. If people are buying it and complaining about it, there's a gap. Claude just helps you find it faster than anyone else is looking.

This is how you use AI to actually make money — not by asking it to write your emails.


#ClaudeAI #AmazonFBA #AIProductResearch #SideHustle #MakeMoneyWithAI
